Subject: Request: SLA credit after Mar 27 outage

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the incident notice earlier. We logged a major impact to our production integration between 03:12–06:05 PT on 2026-03-27 (roughly 173 minutes of total downtime for our critical endpoints). Under our contract (Section 3.2, monthly uptime), Borealis is eligible for a service credit when monthly uptime drops below 99.9%.

Please can you confirm:
- Whether this incident qualifies for a credit under Redwood's SLA.
- The credit calculation and dollar amount (we need this for our internal finance and to reconcile the April invoice).
- Expected timing for issuance/application to our account.

I can share our internal incident timeline if that helps — attaching our basic timeline.

Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Thanks,
Priya Gupta

Borealis Health

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodinf.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SLA credit after Mar 27 outage — proposed calc attached

Hi all,

Attached is the SLA-Calc spreadsheet (SLA-Calc-Borealis-20260328.xlsx) and a short incident timeline (Incident-Timeline-Borealis-20260327.pdf). I walked through Redwood's SLA table in the customer agreement:

- Monthly uptime commitment: 99.9%
- Measured month: Mar 1–Mar 31 (44,640 minutes)
- Total aggregated downtime affecting Borealis production endpoints as validated: 173 minutes

Observed uptime = (44,640 - 173) / 44,640 = 99.612%
That places Borealis in the SLA bracket: uptime < 99.9% and >= 99.5% => 10% service credit of monthly recurring charges (per contract appendix).

Per our records, Borealis's monthly committed spend (MRR under the contract) is $30,000.
Proposed credit = 10% * $30,000 = $3,000.

Notes and considerations:
- We verified that the root cause was a regional networking regression on our side (see incident report) and not client-side misconfiguration.
- Credit cap per contract: 50% of monthly fees. This calc is well below cap.
- If Borealis disputes the downtime minutes, we can reconcile timestamps; I used the intersection of our server logs and Borealis's timeline.

Requesting:
- Markus/Legal: confirm no additional approvals required for standard credit issuance.
- Laura/Finance: confirm whether we will apply as an invoice adjustment (April invoice) or issue a credit memo.

Once finance confirms, Rishi, please send the Signed Credit Form to Priya and we'll process.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA-Calc-Borealis-20260328.xlsx; Incident-Timeline-Borealis-20260327.pdf
